issues.description: Method visibility mismatch for Animal.messageOnFeed(): The problem statement UML (problem_statement.md) declares the method as public abstract (shown as '+ messageOnFeed():String' in the UML at line 28). The solution implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java) declares the method as protected abstract (signature: 'protected abstract String messageOnFeed();' at line 18). This inconsistency between the UML/spec and the reference implementation can confuse students about the intended access level and expected usage (e.g., whether other non-subclass types in the package or external callers should treat the method as publicly accessible).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent: either change the solution implementation to declare the method public (change 'protected abstract String messageOnFeed();' to 'public abstract String messageOnFeed();' in Animal.java) to match the UML/spec, or update the problem statement/UML to indicate protected visibility explicitly so all artifacts and instructions align.
